text: The Deputy City Clerk, Secretariat will provide a presentation on the rules of procedure for meetings of the Board. The Integrity Commissioner will provide a presentation on the Role of the Integrity Commissioner and the Code of Conduct for Members of Local Boards. The Lobbyist Registrar will provide a presentation on the Lobbying By-law and lobbyist regulations. The Director, Corporate Intergovernmental and Agency Relations, City Manager's Office, will give a presentation on Governance and the City of Toronto Public Service By-law.

The Toronto Realty Agency: 1. Referred the letter from the Integrity Commissioner to the Transition Lead, Toronto Realty Agency for consideration when developing policies, operating procedures and policy framework.
